name: Brant Business Interiors
description: Brant Business Interiors is a family-owned Ontario commercial office furniture dealer at 296 George St N, Peterborough — toll-free 1-800-835-9565, quote response within 1 business day. Family-owned since 1964. OECM Supplier Partner under Agreement 2025-470. Part of the Office Central Group of Companies.

mainEntity.name: Can I order across every business furniture category under OECM Agreement 2025-470?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Agreement 2025-470 covers Brant Business Interiors' full business furniture catalog — seating, desks, storage, tables, boardroom, ergonomic products, panels & dividers, and accessories. Ontario school boards, hospitals, municipalities, colleges, and not-for-profits can issue a single OECM purchase order spanning multiple categories without running an open RFP per category. Send the requisition to quotes@brantbusinessinteriors.com or call 1-800-835-9565 and reference Agreement 2025-470.

mainEntity.name: How do I request a single quote that spans multiple product categories?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send your scope — a line-item list, headcount, room count, or a floor plan — through our online quote form, by email to quotes@brantbusinessinteriors.com, or by phone at 1-800-835-9565. We'll return one itemized quote covering every category in your project (seating, desks, storage, tables, boardroom, ergonomic, panels, accessories) with single PO routing, one delivery coordinator, and one installation crew. Typical turnaround on a multi-category quote is one business day.

mainEntity.name: What's included in delivery and installation for a multi-category office fit-out?

acceptedAnswer.text: All quotes include delivery and installation as separate line items so you see the full landed cost before you cut the PO. For multi-category projects, we coordinate a single delivery window, place each piece in-room with our own crew, assemble and level the furniture, and remove all packaging before we leave. After-hours and weekend installs can typically be arranged for occupied spaces — ask during quoting. We deliver across Ontario; for out-of-province shipments, call us for a freight quote.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer space planning for a full office fit-out across categories?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our design team produces free space plans for any fit-out above roughly six stations — your floor plan with the furniture mix laid in (seating, desks, storage, panels, tables, accessories) so your team can approve the layout before the PO is cut. Learn about our free design layout service →
